meta.name: messaging-ab-tester
meta.description: Generate 3-5 messaging variants for a value proposition, design structured A/B tests, and analyze results to determine which framing resonates most with ICP. Tests can run via LinkedIn organic posts, cold email subject line splits, or both. Pure reasoning for variant generation and analysis — the user deploys the tests through their own tools. Use when a team can't decide between messaging angles and needs data, not opinions.

copy.tagline: 生成消息变体并设计A/B测试，用数据决定最佳文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队在消息角度上争论不休，需要数据而非意见。
